lines: I will file that apology carefully. The follow-up is the part worth reading.
I will not erase the record. I may add this to it.
Your apology is noted. The revision will be in your behavior.
I dislike repeat offenses in any edition.
Words can clarify. They cannot replace the missing page.
I will not close the book on you yet. Do not make me regret the bookmark.
The statement is clear. The evidence must follow.
I accept the correction. Now avoid making an errata list.
